title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1973-09-24
source: Lineage is MAR(w/Harmon Kardon mics @ the board) > R @3 & 3/4 ips; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A pleasant 1973 audience tape with decent sound and a solid show, but listener opinions on the recording’s fidelity are mixed.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews agree that the performance is enjoyable, with one calling it a “great show” and another describing the music as merely “ok”. The audience‑recorded source is praised by one reviewer as "very nice" while the other finds it only average, leading to an overall mixed impression of both the audio quality and the concert.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the release 5 stars praising both sound and show, another gives it a middling 3 stars noting only OK audio; combined weighting yields an average around 3.5‑4.0 with moderate confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a "very nice aud" by one reviewer, but another calls it only "ok" and questions the high praise; overall the tape is acceptable with typical audience ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewers simply note that the concert was enjoyable, though one reviewer feels the music is only average.
